policies.jina_two_stage_full: two 10-candidate stage-1 windows, retain native Top-5 from each, then native Jina stage-2 over ten survivors
policies.jina_two_stage_pplxtext: same windows and survivor rule, using the frozen E11 per-passage budget strings for both stages
policies.jina_pplx_budget: one native Jina call over the frozen E11 budgeted 20-candidate view

survivor_order_rule: stage-1 survivors are concatenated window-one then window-two, each in descending native score with stable original-position tie-breaking; stage-2 receives that ten-item order
failure_rule: any failed native call fails the request; failed requests remain in raw output and receive offline metric zero
timed_boundary: view preparation + native scoring + score parsing + candidate-ID mapping + Top-5 packaging

analysis.metric: known-positive nDCG@5 normalized by min(gold_count, 5), failure=0
holm_family: pplx_two_stage - jina_two_stage_full on mean shuffled order
analysis.determinism_recheck: 20 random non-timing requests after the timing workload

historical_reuse.pplx_two_stage: authenticated R3 raw outputs reused; no PPLX re-inference unless the raw reuse integrity check fails
historical_reuse.original_jina_full: authenticated original native outputs reused for offline comparison
historical_reuse.new_calls: Jina policies in this continuation namespace
